items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; team informed him he will be inactive Sunday vs DET as details finalized. Time in AZ done; no deal until after Sunday games. Houston among teams in mix.
items.why: Trade talks advanced; AZ comfortable enough to sit him knowing deal imminent.
items.implication: Zero Week 5 fantasy value; destination TBD impacts ROS. Michael Wilson primary beneficiary in AZ offense.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Michael Wilson and remaining AZ WRs (Bourne szn potential).

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) OUT for Sunday vs ATL; Tyler Huntley to start. Also other Ravens outs.
items.why: Ankle injury from prior week; official ruling.
items.implication: Major QB downgrade; limits upside for Flowers/Andrews/Likely in non-Lamar offense.
items.opportunity: Huntley game script may increase checkdowns but lower overall efficiency/ceiling for pass catchers.

items.text: Saquon Barkley OUT (hamstring) for Eagles Week 5 vs JAX (London). Also DeVonta Smith OUT.
items.why: Hamstring injury; ruled out on final report. Corroborated by team/Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: Major RB downgrade; Eagles backfield and pass game shift. Goedert IN as potential RZ/target bump.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for PHI RB backups; more targets to remaining WRs/TE.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will start Sunday vs Giants; WR Stefon Diggs OUT (hamstring). ETR lists Daniels/Rachaad White IN, Diggs OUT, McLaurin Q.
items.why: Official reports; Daniels cleared to start, Diggs hamstring rules him out.
items.implication: Daniels upgrade to starter; Diggs zero value. McLaurin GTD impacts both.
items.opportunity: More targets to remaining WAS WRs/TEs if McLaurin also limited; Daniels rushing upside.

items.text: MHJ had only 5 catches in 4 games and was not a real factor in Michael Wilson usage. Trade/inactive means Kia Kendrick Bourne szn; low overall impact note on prior Wilson projections.
items.why: MHJ low production/volume already; absence consolidates targets without major prior cannibalization of Wilson.
items.implication: Wilson remains strong play; Bourne speculative upside in vacated role.
items.opportunity: Target share expansion for Wilson/Bourne post-MHJ.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (with AD Mitchell) for Jets Week 5.
items.implication: Jets RB committee or backups elevated; zero Hall value.

items.text: Dallas Goedert IN (knee, practiced); Chris Olave IN; Jeremiyah Love IN; Jayden Daniels IN. Contrast to multiple high-profile OUTs.
items.why: Friday injury board designations after practice participation.
items.implication: Reliable starts; Goedert especially boosted by Barkley/Smith OUTs for targets/RZ.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full snap/route shares expected.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love IN (not on final IR); ankle maintenance but 'full-go'. ETR projects him 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier with much bigger/better workload expected vs Week 4 usage criticism. Tough projection balancing downside.
items.why: Not on final injury report; media/fan pressure on prior usage; gut for expanded role despite ankle/long season risk and Allgeier competition.
items.implication: Strong RB play/start candidate; clear lead over Allgeier in projections.
items.opportunity: Expanded snap/carry/route share and goal-line work.

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (among others including OT/S).
items.implication: Ladd McConkey (Q himself) and other Chargers WRs see expanded opportunity.
items.opportunity: Higher target/route share for McConkey/Johnston backups.

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-risk later this season despite greatness: knee becoming real issue (missed practice sore knee), can't shake shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) boomer tendencies. Frustration over low 2nd-half targets noted. Still good play short-term.
items.why: Stacked injury (knee/shoulder), QB/coaching risks, expressed frustration on usage.
items.implication: Monitor closely ROS; short-term startable but elevated downside risk profile.
items.opportunity: Usage already showed 2H drop; further injury could limit snaps/routes.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8. Volume including red zone + matchup vs Titans defense struggles vs WRs.
items.opportunity: High target/RZ share in positive game script.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5. Workload + matchup vs defense carved by RBs; ties to potential Bengals WR injuries boosting checkdowns.
items.why: Solid workload hard to ignore + soft run defense + possible pass-game injury cascade.
items.opportunity: Carries + potential increased targets if Chase/Higgins limited.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET (WR10, volume/RZ), Christian Watson vs CHI (WR15, coverage matchup), Isaiah Likely @ WSH (TE5, positional weakness).
items.why: Usage (targets/RZ for Wilson) + specific defensive matchups/coverage holes.
items.implication: Startable WR2/3 and TE1 upside plays. Wilson further boosted by MHJ inactive.
items.opportunity: Elevated target shares and favorable individual matchups.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41, injury wrinkle + usage/matchup), Mark Andrews @ ATL (TE17, thin role/numbers with Lamar out context), Cam Skattebo @ WSH (RB20), Tony Pollard vs HOU (RB28), Jalen Hurts vs JAX (QB15, rough stretch + OL).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin/inefficient roles, usage data, game environments, injury notes (Addison), Lamar absence impact (Andrews), OL/rough play (Hurts).
items.implication: Fade/sit these; look elsewhere for safer options.
